# Post-Completion Phase Two: Critique and Improvements

> The Awtsmoos tests the smallest polish against the widest consequence;
> Awtsmoos.com keeps one icon, one handoff, and one route in truthful sequence.

## Critique of Phase One

A favicon-only patch would silence one request but leave the repository's human guidance dangerously false. A documentation-only patch would preserve the browser 404. A global favicon would solve the request but couple Mitzvah World to every unrelated route. The post-completion pass must close both browser and handoff drift while preserving the proven runtime artifact unchanged.

## Improvements

1. Keep the icon beside the route shell, not beneath ignored runtime media.
2. Use SVG so no binary-generation tool or opaque asset is required.
3. Avoid scripts, fonts, external references, and embedded raster data.
4. Match the existing dark-green and gold page palette.
5. Include accessible `<title>` and `<desc>` metadata inside the SVG.
6. Declare `type="image/svg+xml"` explicitly in HTML.
7. Use a route-relative icon URL so local and production paths agree.
8. Preserve the import map, stylesheet, root markup, and compact entry exactly.
9. Add a focused source test for the icon file and HTML declaration.
10. Assert the route shell still loads the compact entry.
11. Assert the icon has no external URL dependency.
12. Assert the icon file begins with the required B"H comment.
13. Rewrite `NEXT_AI_README.md` around the current launcher and runtime global.
14. Document the deterministic compact build command.
15. Document Drive-backed model ownership instead of local Git media.
16. Rewrite `REMAINING_WORK.md` as a closed evidence ledger.
17. Avoid hard-coding a release commit that future maintenance will immediately stale.
18. Record current verified bundle hash as evidence with an explicit verification date.
19. Run the route-shell test independently from CompactJS tests.
20. Verify direct HTTP 200 for the SVG after deployment.
21. Run a fresh browser trace and require zero favicon request failures.
22. Confirm playable state and movement remain unchanged after shell-only work.

## Refined Scope

Authorized source files: `index.html`, `mitzvah-world-icon.svg`, one new route-shell test, `NEXT_AI_README.md`, and `REMAINING_WORK.md`. CompactJS and gameplay modules are read-only in this pass.
